public_data: Independent toy text and hand-constructed 3-D vectors only. No real corpus, questions, vectors or personal evaluation outputs.

contract.semantic_only: Explicit startup policy; target=events only; up to256 vector candidates sorted by cosine, no lexical-only extras.
contract.semantic_first: Explicit startup policy; target=events only; semantic order first, lexical-only extras afterward; priority-rank scores, not cosine.
contract.identifier_override: Explicit existing identifier_prefix override can prioritize exact identifier matches in hybrid/semantic_first; semantic_only rejects the contradictory override.
contract.fallback: Unavailable vectors preserve visible existing fallback ranking; score_kind does not falsely claim cosine.
contract.cursor: Binds policy even when fallback rankings coincide.
contract.scope: No per-query policy override, new provider request, learned threshold, question-specific tuning, Memory/navigation mode change or permission expansion.

new_synthetic_cases: Semantic paraphrase winner loses under equal-weight RRF but stays first under both explicit semantic policies.
Lexical-only extras appear after vector candidates under semantic_first and are absent under semantic_only.
Rare identifier gets literal priority only with explicit identifier override.
Opposite/negated instructions retain exact text and speaker roles; explicit user-role filter excludes assistant evidence. Similarity alone is not entailment.
Foreign access scopes still yield no event candidates under both new policies.
Cursors cannot cross policies even when an uncached query falls back to identical lexical results.
limits: Known-question regression is not blind validation or answer-quality measurement.
No unseen-session generalization claim; independent unseen questions and matching query vectors remain necessary.
Default remains hybrid for compatibility; explicit semantic_first is a scoped operator choice, not an inferred query-topic heuristic.
Queries absent from supplied caches still lack semantic vectors; no automatic provider integration.
UTF-8 result bytes and MCP framing bytes must not be labeled model tokens.
